sources.summary: A fixed company event changed the near-term operating path.
A fixed market dislocation snapshot for disabled-source testing.
A fixed official policy change has a measurable second-order effect.
A fixed expectation primitive differs from the observable path.

change_event_scout.title: Fixture event propagation gap
change_event_scout.why_now: A new versioned company fact arrived before broad repricing.
change_event_scout.expectation: Consensus assumes the old operating path persists.
change_event_scout.variant_wedge: The fixture implies faster adoption than consensus.
change_event_scout.falsifier: Reject if the next measured update reverts to the old path.

market_dislocation_scout.title: Fixture market dislocation
market_dislocation_scout.why_now: A bounded price and volume move diverges from fixed evidence.
market_dislocation_scout.expectation: The move implies a larger deterioration than the fixture supports.
market_dislocation_scout.variant_wedge: Normalized conditions imply partial mean reversion.
market_dislocation_scout.falsifier: Reject if the next bounded snapshot confirms deterioration.

causal_policy_scout.title: Fixture policy second-order beneficiary
causal_policy_scout.why_now: An official change has entered its implementation window.
causal_policy_scout.expectation: Consensus focuses on the direct effect only.
causal_policy_scout.variant_wedge: A measurable second-order beneficiary is underweighted.
causal_policy_scout.falsifier: Reject if the implementation milestone is delayed.

expectation_gap_scout.title: Fixture expectation gap
expectation_gap_scout.why_now: Observable progress now differs from the frozen expectation.
expectation_gap_scout.expectation: The price path implies no improvement.
expectation_gap_scout.variant_wedge: The fixed primitive shows improvement before consensus updates.
expectation_gap_scout.falsifier: Reject if the next primitive loses its positive direction.
